services.title: Green Pest Control
services.text: Our technicians provide pest control services in Houston using products applied according to the label, designed with your home and family in mind.
points: Interior treated on the initial service, or at request of the customer
Exterior treatments every 2 months to keep your pest barrier in place
Initial treatments scheduled for 90 minutes, recurring appointments for 30 minutes

services.title: Ant Control
services.text: When we first visit your home, we'll look for and treat entry points and ant infested areas. We'll also look for and treat areas that could attract ants, such as moist areas, holes in sheetrock, or the inside of cabinets.
points: Exterior serviced every two months for an invisible twenty foot barrier around your home
Fire ants, carpenter ants, acrobat ants and pharaoh ants
Treated with thyme, rosemary, cinnamon, cloves and wintergreen oils

services.title: Roach Control
services.text: We only use friendly pest control techniques to treat cockroaches. Our botanical-based treatments make sure that you, your family, and your pets aren't exposed to dangerous chemicals that can cause sickness and discomfort.
points: An inspection, then treatment of roach infested areas and entry points
An invisible 20 ft barrier around your home to keep roaches away
Green solutions designed to treat American and German roaches

services.title: Flea & Tick Control
services.text: Elevate your home's protection from fleas and ticks with preventive treatments from Natran.
points: Monthly outdoor fogging all year long, or for the nine-month peak season of March through November
Full interior and exterior treatment with a follow-up 21 days later
Our outdoor preventive treatment kills both fleas and ticks

groups.title: Termite Control
groups.summary: A termite infestation can get out of control quickly and requires swift action to minimize costly damages.
groups.intro: Texas has a lot of termites. In fact, Houston has one of the highest rates of termites per acre in the whole of the US. We provide fast and effective eco-conscious treatments and prevention systems that will fortify your home, with same-day or next day inspections available.
groups.imageAlt: Close up of termite damage on wood

services.title: Sentricon® Bait System
services.text: Protect your home from termites with the nation's #1 termite baiting system. The bait system will be installed around your home's perimeter and placed above ground around your home when needed, too.
points: Sentricon install starting at $499, initial service free
Covers Eastern Subterranean Termites and Formosan Subterranean Termites
It won't harm any plants, animals, or people

services.title: Free Termite Inspection
services.text: It's not always easy to identify a termite infestation since their activity is usually hidden behind walls and siding. Our termite certified experts know what signs to look for, and can also provide you with recommendations to minimize your chance of infestation.
points: Get started with a FREE termites inspection to receive your personalized quote
Same-day or next day inspections available

services.title: Annual System Inspection
services.text: As part of your plan, we go the extra mile to complete a comprehensive inspection of the home and system every year, ensuring that your home remains protected for as long as you have service with us.
points: If subterranean termite activity ever surfaces, we'll gladly reinspect and treat as necessary at no additional cost
Dry wood termites are not treated by Natran

groups.title: Mosquito Control
groups.summary: Relief is only a call away. Take back your backyard with solutions tailored to your home and outdoor needs.
groups.intro: We know how quickly mosquitoes can ruin your outdoor oasis. We provide fast, effective solutions so your family can enjoy bite-free adventures all year long. We have 3 main methods of removing mosquitoes: mosquito traps, mosquito fogging and mosquito misting systems.

services.title: EcoYard
services.text: EcoYard provides comprehensive mosquito and flea protection by combining several of our solutions into one convenient service, protecting your family and pets from dangerous viruses and diseases that are spread by mosquitos, fleas, and ticks.
points: Multi-Pest Yard Fog Treatments
Mosquito Traps
Granulation Treatment
Starting at $140 per month

services.title: Mosquito Misting System
services.text: Our plant-based, organic mist kills mosquitoes on contact. Your Natran technician will install the misting system and nozzles into your yard and will set them to go off automatically, but you can also control the misting system remotely, too.
points: Get started with a FREE site inspection and system design
Works best when paired with our mosquito traps

services.title: In2Care Mosquito Traps
services.text: Our innovative mosquito traps work to address each stage of the mosquito reproductive cycle. They work by disrupting the mosquito reproductive cycle, stopping the eggs (within 400 square meters!) from developing.
points: Starting at $109 per month
They also don't hurt other insects or birds

services.title: Botanical Mosquito Fogging
services.text: This treatment uses a botanical-based solution to fog your outdoor space. The fog kills mosquitoes on contact, keeping the whole area a mosquito-free zone.
points: Monthly mosquito fogs starting at $131 per month
We recommend treatments every 2 weeks for most customers
People and pets can go straight outside to enjoy the yard after we fog

groups.title: Rodent Control
groups.summary: Rats and mice compromise the health and safety of everyone in the home, so it's important to act quickly.
groups.intro: We use environmentally-conscious methods to remove rodents from your home. Once the rodents are removed, your Natran technician will seal your entry points so that the rodents can't come back, and disinfect the area with our botanical-based treatments. We have a 4-step proven process to eliminate infestations and prevent future entries.
groups.imageAlt: A gray mouse on brown wood

services.title: Free Inspection
services.text: We look at every aspect of your building, including the foundations, the exterior walls, the exposed pipelines, the attic, and the roof.

services.title: Full Exclusion
services.text: This is where we look to find every single entry and exit point for rodents in your home.
points: Sealed with top-quality materials including expanding foam and high-gauge steel wire mesh

services.title: Friendly Removal
services.text: After we've sealed all of the entry and exit points, we begin humanely catching the rodents.
points: Snap traps, glue boards and bait box traps, sized to the severity of your infestation
Scheduled return visits to check the traps until the rodents are all gone

services.title: Fast Clean Up
services.text: Our final visit will be where we decontaminate your home, releasing our green, botanical-based disinfectant as a fog.
points: The fog eliminates bacteria and other nasties left over from droppings, urine, and nesting materials

groups.title: Wildlife Removal
groups.summary: Exclusions for critters like raccoons, squirrels, and opossums that find their way into your attic and garages.
groups.intro: It can be really concerning to have animals hiding out in your home. Luckily, we can get those critters out of your home responsibly and seal the opening to prevent reentering. Our tried and tested method will solve your problem and prevent those critters from returning, without harming the critter.
groups.imageAlt: A raccoon standing on a wooden deck

services.title: Raccoons
services.text: Racoons are nocturnal, so you're unlikely to see them during the day. They can grow to around 2-3 ft in length and can cause damage to your home's wood, electrical wiring, insulation, and more.
points: While racoons may look adorable, they can carry rabies, so it's very important that you get them removed quickly

services.title: Opossums
services.text: It's not unusual for Houstonians to find opossums in their home. Your Natran technician will put together a plan to get the Opossum out without harming the Opossum, along with a plan to stop them coming back.

services.title: Squirrels
services.text: If they get inside your property, they can nibble and break electrical wires and build their nests from almost anything they can find (including insulation!).
points: We'll quickly remove the squirrels and put preventative measures in place so they don't come back

about.title: Houston's original green pest control company.
text: Natran is Houston’s first, people-friendly pest control service, keeping our corner of the world safer and cleaner with every job we do.

We offer customized, holistic solutions to the everyday problem of household pests — using powerful botanically based pesticides and expertly trained pest management professionals — Natran provides home- and business-owners with year-round protection and priceless peace-of-mind.
At Natran Green Pest Control, we always strive to treat your home or business like it’s our very own. That means we’ll give you the same care and respect we value ourselves.
about.imageAlt: Two Natran technicians inspecting a kitchen

values.title: Speak to Real People
values.text: When you call us, you'll speak to someone in our Natran family. They're friendly, they're experts, and they're here to help you get your home back.

values.title: Kind to Butterflies
values.text: Butterflies play a crucial role in our ecosystem and we take extra care to make sure we're mindful of them (and other creatures!) in our work.

values.title: No Harsh Chemicals
values.text: We use plant-based treatments to reduce the number of harsh chemicals you, the community, and the planet are exposed to.

faqs.q: Can you come to my house today?
faqs.a: Possibly! In most cases, we can perform same day services if you call our office before 2 pm, depending on route volume. If you call after 2 pm, next day service is the next best thing!

faqs.q: How long do your treatments last?
faqs.a: Our products break down naturally with the elements of the environment (such as UV rays and moisture). To ensure your pest barrier stays in place, we recommend exterior treatments every 2 months (6 times a year). Products inside the home can last much longer, which is why we only treat the inside of the home on the initial service, or at request of the customer. This helps reduce the amount of product to which you and your family are exposed. For mosquito yard fogs, we recommend treatments every 2 weeks for most customers, however some locations, especially those near water sources, may benefit from weekly fogs.

faqs.q: Is Natran an organic pest control company?
faqs.a: Natran is a green pest control company licensed and regulated by the Texas Department of Agriculture and the Structural Pest Control Services. We treat pests with minimum and reduced risk products, (e.g. botanical insecticides/mineral based dusts and powders). Our licensed professionals are trained and dedicated to design a low impact people, planet, and pet friendly pest control plan that fit each individual's needs.

faqs.q: How safe is Natran pest control for my children and pets?
faqs.a: Our products and methods are effective and reduced to minimal risk, FIFRA 23b classified.

For most homes, initial treatments are scheduled for 90 minutes, and recurring service appointments are scheduled for 30 minutes. Some treatments could take longer depending on the size of the home and the severity of the infestation.

faqs.q: Do you take care of rats, possums, mice, squirrels, and racoons?
faqs.a: Yes we do. A technician will come out and give you a free no obligation estimate. The specialist will identify entry holes and design a plan to rid your home of invaders and prevent future critters from entering the home.

faqs.q: Can you take care of snakes in my yard?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer a snake repelling service. Our specialist will create a barrier around the property that will help prevent snakes from entering the yard. It's a granular that lasts about a month. For best results, we recommend a recurring service every 30 days March – November.
No, but we can recommend some pest control companies that do. Just give us a call for our recommendation for the Houston or Austin area.

faqs.q: Do you treat dry wood termites?
faqs.a: No we do not. In my opinion the best way to kill off dry wood termites is to tent and fumigate the structure. Unlike subterranean termites, the dry wood termites don't require moisture from the soil to survive.

faqs.q: What type of payment do you accept?
faqs.a: We require credit cards on file for any recurring service. Checks and cash will be accepted for single services only and are due at the time of the service.
Yes! We can help you prevent fleas with exterior treatments, or if you have an active infestation, we'll work quickly to eliminate the population with a specialty treatment.

Our technician will treat the entire property with a product that is designed to break down slowly. Within 30 minutes after the treatment you will be able to enjoy a significant reduction in the mosquito population. Our Pest Management Professionals will treat the yard's harborage areas for mosquitoes to suppress the population and give a “quick” knockdown.

faqs.q: How long does the mosquito fog last?
faqs.a: We recommend treating the property March-November and having your yard fogged every 2 weeks to make sure there's a consistent reduction in population. Botanical Insecticides and Minimal Risk Products are designed to break down faster so rainfall could hinder performance significantly.

For pest control we recommend exterior follow-up treatments every 2 months. For mosquito yards fogs we recommend follow up treatments every 2 weeks for most customers, however some prefer weekly fogs. The environment and climate can affect the products residual. UV light and moisture deteriorate products quicker.

faqs.q: I won't be home when you visit, so I can't put my dog inside. What should I do?
faqs.a: Is there a better day when you can put your dog in? We prefer to treat when people/pets are not present to allow the product to dry uniformly. Can we reschedule for the backyard? Can we treat the front today or would you rather have it all done on the same day? If not, we can't fog.

We keep your credit card details on file for recurring services and offer auto-pay to make your pest control one less thing to worry about. Credit cards, checks and cash are accepted for single services and are paid at the time of the service. We accept all major credit cards, including American Express, Visa, Mastercard, and Discover. We can't accept ACH payments at this time.
